coverage_notes: Executed 12 targeted web searches focused on sole/only/full-service grocery loss, disaster-related food-distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption.
No qualifying signal was verified within the bounded prior-hour window.

Hill Country Community Ministries listed its October 2 Bethany United Methodist Church Fresh Food For All distribution as canceled, but the direct page provided no disaster/outage/facility-damage cause and no publication/update timestamp establishing that the cancellation was newly posted in-window, so it was excluded.
South Texas Food Bank was monitoring flood conditions on October 2, but available reporting described preparedness/continued assistance rather than a canceled distribution or service interruption.
Older sole-grocery-store and food-bank storm-closure incidents were excluded as stale/duplicate candidates.
